name: wf-caps
description: wf default-capabilities pack — non-core, stack/domain-specific capabilities for the wf workflow, composed with wf core via the capability registry. Ships the migration capability (migration-map: C#/MVC -> Angular/TS mapping), the audit capability (five domain-free adversarial verify lenses: correctness, security, convention, consistency, operational, plus an optional composite retrospective report), the browser-qa capability (qa-engine: stack-agnostic browser-automation QA engine), the angular stack capability (qa-host + test-page: Angular test-host scaffolding, qa-execution host provider), and the node-ts stack capability (test-node: pure-helper Node test harness).
